item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. There will be a few showers and isolated thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, there will still be a few showers over southern China early next week. Another trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the region in the middle and latter parts of next week.
